subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, and subscription contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting non-mentioned Space ingestion changes the channel's data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scope, and event-subscription security boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub support with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhooks Only
options.body: Leave the official Google Chat plugin on the current service-account webhook model and handle only the narrower thread-routing bugs.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a broader Google Workspace credential and event-subscription model before adding all-message Space ingestion to this plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub support with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across Google Chat thread, policy, and auth-adjacent files and is the best available routing owner for the product/security choice.
